name: EPIC 210450414
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 4, 12.9 solar radii and 0.92 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 1,178 parsecs away, 13 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 4, give 0.92 solar masses and 12.9 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,547 K at its surface.
